required_behavior: Open the selected existing session in a separate OS window of its provider Desktop app

source_evidence.observation: The threads URL becomes a localConversation route. The route is queued and dispatched through an ensured existing/main app window. No external independent-window selector was identified in this inspected path.
The open-in-new-window host message validates a path and invokes the separate-window callback. This is separate from the OS deep-link handler.
The internal UI dispatches open-in-new-window with the conversation path when the feature gate permits it.

codex.external_independent_window_entrypoint: Windows UI Automation File menu New Window InvokePattern, followed by the official thread deep link

runtime_independent_window_test.method: Native C# System.Windows.Automation; no Computer Use tool, screenshot, coordinate click, keystroke injection or model prompt

codex.conclusion: Native semantic UI Automation plus deep link successfully opened the target in a separate OS window. A reusable helper still needs bounded waits, target validation and failure handling.
